description.value: Mary Brown's is a 100% Canadian-owned fast-food chain founded in 1969, specializing in hand-cut, hand-breaded fresh chicken and hand-crafted potato taters made from whole Canadian-grown potatoes. This Langley location offers takeout service and is part of nearly 300 locations coast-to-coast. It's a straightforward hot-meal stop for a touring cyclist passing through the 204 Street corridor.
